build_axis_list: build a comma-separated list of axis TypeVar short names for a given number of axes
create_jax_array_type: create a generic JAX array type string parameterised by a number of axes
generate_transpose_axes: generate all possible transpose axis configurations for an array of given rank
generate_reduction_axes: generate all possible reduction axis configurations for an array of given rank
summarize_reduction_axes: summarize the ReductionAxes namedtuple fields for encoding reduction operation axes
